page.title: Legal entities
page.intro: The companies in your group, each with its own legal settings. A report’s entity comes from the portal address the reporter used. Settings an entity doesn’t set come from your organization defaults.
page.emptyBody: Without entities, every report is filed at organization level. Add one for each company that needs its own address, pack or retention.
page.missingBody: Some required organization defaults aren’t set yet, so entities that inherit them have no value.

hints.code: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, e.g. acme_insurance. It can’t be changed later.
hints.calendar: Whose weekend and holidays time this entity’s cases.
hints.regulators: The regulators of the active packs in your region.
hints.regulatorsNone: No regulators are listed for your region’s packs yet. Type a regulator code and press Enter.
hints.aliases: Short names or former names, to help staff recognise it.

form.settingsIntro: Each setting follows your organization defaults unless you override it here.
form.arabicMissing: This entity has no Arabic name. Both names are now required, so add it before saving.

errors.identifier: Use lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
errors.identifierTaken: Another entity already uses this identifier.
errors.nameAr: Enter the Arabic name. Both names are required.
errors.retention: Enter a whole number of years, 0 or more.
errors.retentionRequired: Enter how many years to keep cases. 0 keeps them forever.
errors.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, such as AED or SAR.
errors.packRegion: That pack is from another region. Choose a pack from your region.
errors.regulatorAllowed: Choose from the regulators in your region: {{codes}}.

tenant.title: Organization defaults
tenant.intro: Every legal entity uses these unless it overrides them. A change here applies at once to every entity that inherits it.
tenant.missingBody: Set these before your entities can rely on them: {{fields}}.
tenant.currencyHint: ISO code, such as AED or SAR.
tenant.platformIntro: Your region is set by Xposer. Contact your account manager to change it.

case.label: Legal entity
case.tenant: Tenant: no entity (filed at organization level)

source.portalTitle: Set by the portal address the reporter used. It can’t be changed.
source.agentTitle: Set by the AI before entities were fixed by the portal address.
source.staffTitle: Set by a staff member before entities were fixed by the portal address.

history.title: Pack history
history.lockedHint: In force today. Changed from a date in the pack history.
history.intro: Each case follows the pack in force on the day it was filed and keeps it for good. To change a pack, add a change from a date: the pack before it ends that day.
history.introReadOnly: Each case follows the pack in force on the day it was filed and keeps it for good. Only a tenant admin can change packs.

kinds.jurisdictionHint: Whose rules apply: deadlines, retention, regulators and the AI notice.
kinds.calendarHint: Whose weekend and holidays time the deadlines.

form.fromHint: From midnight on this day. The earliest date is {{date}}; if cases were already filed, choose tomorrow or later.

history.emptyEntity: No entries yet. This entity follows the tenant’s packs.
history.confirmBody: The change to {{pack}} from {{date}} won’t happen, and the pack before it stays in force.

errors.overlap: Choose a date after {{date}}. To replace a scheduled change, cancel it first.
errors.beforeCase: A case was already filed under the old pack. Choose a later date.
errors.noChange: That is already the pack from that date.
errors.concurrent: Someone else changed this at the same moment. The history has been reloaded; try again.
errors.alreadyStarted: This change is already in force. Add a new change instead.
errors.date: Choose a date on or after {{date}}.
errors.notAllowed: Only a tenant admin can change packs.
errors.notAllowedRead: You don’t have access to this pack history.
errors.loadFailed: The pack history couldn’t be loaded.
